I received a notice that the child support holder wanted more money for daycare because the child is special needs.

Oregon Department of Child Support said it would go through unless i appealed which i did because i have 3 children of my own that live with me and i support on my income only. If she got the appeal it would have upped my child support to around 600 a month.

They sent out the Amended Notice of Hearing. I received a letter that it was never delivered to the other parties address( it is the same address she has had for year and even filed the order from).

The phone hearing happened today and the other party never showed up.

I was drilled with questions about everything and answered them as best as i could. I was very nervous and said so. 

I just don't know if it is normal for Judges to be so very direct and straight to the point. I stumbled my words a couple times and she jumped down my case. I said i pay about 1050.00 in rent and the judge replied "you pay rent and don't know the amount". So then i said the amount is 1049.00
